name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-lyricscom
description: Search song lyrics on lyrics.com by word or by title, and fetch full lyrics. No API key required.

environmentVariables.name: LYRICSCOM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to lyrics.com.

environmentVariables.name: LYRICSCOM_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
